summary: Describes a model for setting up IP addresses and subnet prefixes on the interfaces of routers that connect to links whose connectivity is not well defined, as in ad hoc wireless networks. It is informational and not a standard.

eli5.summary: In a game where players keep moving around, you cannot assume who is next to whom. This explains how to give out network addresses when neighbors keep changing.

questions: ip addressing in ad hoc networks
how to assign addresses in manet
